module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
block_note: The register turns over inside this block. Levels 22's signs are the last of the formal notices; from the third item onward the texts are messages, where English words are dropped in freely, subjects and auxiliaries disappear, and कृपया is replaced by tone.

grammar_prep_card.title_en: Time Clauses with When and Then (जब ... तब)
grammar_prep_card.explanation_en: Hindi builds time clauses using the correlative pair 'जब ... तब' (when ... then). Just like with relative pronouns, Hindi requires both halves to be present: 'जब बारिश रुकी, तब हम निकले' (When the rain stopped, [then] we left). You will also see 'जब तक' (until / as long as) paired with 'तब तक', and 'जैसे ही' (as soon as) paired with 'वैसे ही'. Remember that 'जब तक' clauses often use a negative 'नहीं' that isn't translated into English.

examples.hindi: जब बारिश रुकी, तब हम निकले।
examples.read_as: jab baarish rukii, tab ham nikle.
examples.english: When the rain stopped, we left.

examples.hindi: जब तक वो नहीं आता, तब तक हम इंतज़ार करेंगे।
examples.read_as: jab tak vo nahiiṁ aataa, tab tak ham iṁtazaar kareṁge.
examples.english: Until he comes, we will wait.

levels.title_en: The last two notices, and the first message

lines.english: Returns and exchanges

lines.hindi: बिल के साथ सात दिन के भीतर सामान बदल सकते हैं
lines.read_as: bil ke saath saat din ke bhiitar saamaan badal sakte haiṁ
lines.english: Goods may be exchanged within seven days with the bill
No refunds

lines.hindi: सेल का सामान वापस नहीं होगा
lines.read_as: sel kaa saamaan vaapas nahiiṁ hogaa
lines.english: Sale items cannot be returned

learn.explanation_en: वापस means back, and वापसी is the return — the -ई suffix from level 2 again, feminine as always. The header also gives you एवं, which is the formal written word for "and". Speech and ordinary writing use और; एवं belongs on notices, in official prose and in ceremonial language. It is a small word and an easy one to miss, but seeing it tells you immediately what kind of text you are in.
learn.register_note_en: एवं (notices, formal prose) · और (everywhere else). Nobody says एवं out loud in conversation.
vocabulary_notes: के भीतर — within, formal. Speech says के अंदर, and both work for time as well as space.
बदलाव — change, masculine, built from बदलना.
सामान — goods or luggage, masculine, and it has no plural form.

practice.question_en: How long do you have to exchange something?

game.question_en: You bought something in the sale three days ago and want your money back. What follows?
options: Neither is possible — it is excluded twice over
You can get a refund within seven days
You would need to ask at the counter
You can exchange it but not get a refund
game.explanation_en: Sale goods cannot be returned at all, and separately there are no refunds on anything. Either line alone would only half-answer it.

lines.english: Left luggage

lines.hindi: सामान जमा करने पर रसीद लें
lines.read_as: saamaan jamaa karne par rasiid leṁ
lines.english: Take a receipt when depositing luggage

lines.hindi: बिना रसीद के सामान वापस नहीं मिलेगा
lines.read_as: binaa rasiid ke saamaan vaapas nahiiṁ milegaa
lines.english: Luggage will not be returned without a receipt
Twenty rupees per bag per day
Keep the receipt carefully

learn.title_en: रसीद — an Urdu-side word on a Sanskrit-side sign
learn.explanation_en: रसीद is a receipt, and unlike most of the sign vocabulary in this module it is Urdu-side and completely at home in speech as well. It sits here beside अमानती (from अमानत, something entrusted, also Urdu-side) and प्रतिदिन (Sanskrit, per day) without any awkwardness at all. Note प्रति doing the same job it did on the parking sign in level 7, now compounded into प्रतिदिन. And सामान जमा करने पर is the oblique infinitive plus पर for the fifth time in the module.
learn.register_note_en: रसीद and बिल are not the same thing: a बिल itemises what you owe, and a रसीद proves you handed something over.
vocabulary_notes: अमानती सामान घर is the standard Indian railway phrase for a cloakroom.
बिना रसीद के — the wrap-around "without" from level 15.
ध्यान से — carefully, using the same ध्यान as ध्यान रखें on the waiting-room sign.

practice.question_en: What does it cost per bag per day?
practice.explanation_en: Line 4: प्रति बैग बीस रुपये प्रतिदिन.

game.question_en: You lose the receipt. What does the sign tell you?
options: You can describe the bag instead
Your luggage will not be given back
You pay a penalty and collect it
You must come back the next day
game.explanation_en: One line makes the receipt the only proof, and the last line exists precisely because of it. The warning to keep it safe is the tell.

lines.hindi: अरे यार सॉरी, मीटिंग में था
lines.read_as: are yaar sôrii, miiṭiṁg meṁ thaa
lines.english: Sorry mate, I was in a meeting
Phone was on silent

lines.hindi: अभी देखा तो तीन मिस्ड कॉल
lines.read_as: abhii dekhaa to tiin misḍ kôl
lines.english: Just looked and there were three missed calls

lines.hindi: सब ठीक है ना? बहुत व्यस्त था आज
lines.read_as: sab ṭhiik hai naa? bahut vyast thaa aaj
lines.english: Everything all right? Been really busy today
Let's talk tomorrow

learn.explanation_en: This is the first message in the module and it undoes almost every habit the signs established. No कृपया — the warmth comes from यार and from ना. No Sanskrit vocabulary except one word. English dropped in without apology: सॉरी, साइलेंट, मिस्ड कॉल, मीटिंग. And subjects and auxiliaries simply gone — मीटिंग में था has no मैं, and तीन मिस्ड कॉल has no verb at all. The one formal-side word is व्यस्त, and it is completely normal here, because busy has no everyday Hindi alternative that is not clumsy.
learn.register_note_en: व्यस्त crosses over. Most Sanskrit-side words would look absurd in a message like this; व्यस्त does not, because there is nothing else to say.
vocabulary_notes: अभी देखा तो — तो carrying a sequence rather than a condition here: I looked, and then.
सब ठीक है ना? — the ना tag from Module 12, inviting reassurance.
कल बात करते हैं — present tense making a plan, exactly as in Module 12.

practice.question_en: Why did he not answer the calls?
options: He was in a meeting with his phone on silent

game.question_en: What does the way this message is written tell you about the two people?
options: They have never met in person
They are colleagues who barely know each other
game.explanation_en: यार, no greeting, no sign-off, English thrown in, and a ना tag asking for reassurance. None of that survives between people who are not close.

summary.recap_en: एवं is "and" on a notice and nowhere else. रसीद proves you handed something over, where a बिल says what you owe. And the module's first message inverts every habit the signs built — no कृपया, English dropped in freely, subjects and auxiliaries gone.
summary.next_up_en: Next: confirmations, postponements and congratulations — three more messages, three different distances.

lines.hindi: नमस्ते सर, आपकी बुकिंग की पुष्टि हो गई है
lines.read_as: namaste sar, aapkii bukiṁg kii puṣṭi ho gaii hai
lines.english: Hello sir, your booking is confirmed

lines.hindi: कमरा नंबर 204, चेक-इन दोपहर 2 बजे के बाद
lines.read_as: kamraa nambar 204, chek-in dopahar 2 baje ke baad
lines.english: Room 204, check-in after 2 p.m.

lines.hindi: कोई भी दिक्कत हो तो इसी नंबर पर मैसेज कर दीजिएगा
lines.read_as: koii bhii dikkat ho to isii nambar par maisej kar diijiegaa
lines.english: If there is any problem at all, message this number
We look forward to seeing you

learn.title_en: Business messaging sits in the middle
learn.explanation_en: This message is neither the notice nor the text to a friend. पुष्टि and इंतज़ार are formal-side; चेक-इन, दिक्कत and मैसेज are casual and English; सर and दीजिएगा are polite without being stiff. That mixture is exactly what a hotel or a shop sends, and it is worth recognising as its own register rather than as a failure to pick one. Note पुष्टि हो गई है rather than पुष्टि कर दी गई है — Hindi prefers letting the confirmation happen to saying who did it.
learn.register_note_en: पुष्टि होना, it gets confirmed · पुष्टि करना, to confirm. A business message will nearly always choose the first, because it avoids naming anybody.
vocabulary_notes: इसी नंबर पर — इस plus ही, this very number.
दिक्कत — trouble or difficulty, Urdu-side and thoroughly everyday.
कर दीजिएगा — the polite future imperative from Module 12, softening an instruction into a request.

practice.explanation_en: Line 2: चेक-इन दोपहर 2 बजे के बाद.

game.question_en: Which of these does the message deliberately not mention?
game.explanation_en: It gives a room, a time and a contact route. The price is absent because the booking is already settled — a confirmation is not a quotation.

lines.english: Hello everyone

lines.hindi: बारिश की वजह से हमें कल का कार्यक्रम स्थगित करना पड़ा
lines.read_as: baarish kii vajah se hameṁ kal kaa kaaryakram sthagit karnaa paṛaa
lines.english: Because of the rain we have had to postpone tomorrow's event
We will announce a new date soon
Money will be refunded
We are sorry for the inconvenience

lines.hindi: कृपया इस मैसेज को आगे भेज दें
lines.read_as: kripayaa is maisej ko aage bhej deṁ
lines.english: Please forward this message
Thank you

learn.title_en: A group announcement is half a notice
learn.explanation_en: This message swings between registers line by line. असुविधा के लिए खेद है in line 5 is lifted straight off the lift notice in level 14 — pure officialese. मैसेज and आगे भेज दें in line 6 are ordinary WhatsApp. That is not carelessness: an announcement to a group is semi-official, and it borrows from both sides deliberately. Note also की वजह से here against के कारण on the level 14 sign — the same pair, and the message chooses the spoken one.
learn.register_note_en: स्थगित is firmly Sanskrit-side and there is no casual equivalent — you would rephrase, as with उपलब्ध. "आगे बढ़ा दिया" is the nearest, and it means moved rather than cancelled-for-now.
vocabulary_notes: कार्यक्रम — a programme or event, masculine.
आगे भेज दें — to forward. आगे, onward, plus the देना vector.
करना पड़ा — the compulsion rung of the obligation ladder: we had no choice.

practice.question_en: Why has the event been postponed?

game.question_en: What does the request to forward the message tell you?
options: The organisers have no other way of reaching everyone
Only some people need to know
Everybody has already been told individually
game.explanation_en: It is addressed to a group and then asks that group to spread it further. Neither the greeting nor the request means much alone.

lines.english: Wow — huge congratulations!

lines.hindi: सुना कि नई जॉब लग गई
lines.read_as: sunaa ki naii jôb lag gaii
lines.english: Heard you got the new job

lines.hindi: तुमने बहुत मेहनत की थी, तुम्हीं इसके हक़दार थे
lines.read_as: tumne bahut mehnat kii thii, tumhiiṁ iske haqdaar the
lines.english: You worked so hard — you deserved it
Your parents must be delighted
So when's the party?

learn.title_en: जॉब लग गई, and a suffix you already know
learn.explanation_en: जॉब is an English word and it is feminine in Hindi, so लग गई. And लगना here means to be obtained — a job attaches itself to you. That is now seven jobs for one verb: felt, seemed, attached, cost, began, a phone connecting, and now a job landing. Note हक़दार in line 3: हक़ is a right, and -दार is the possessing suffix from level 5, so a हक़दार is one who has the right to something. A suffix taught in a vocabulary block turning up unannounced in a WhatsApp message is the point of interleaving them.
learn.register_note_en: बधाई (everyday, universal) · मुबारक (Urdu-side, warm) · शुभकामनाएँ (Sanskrit-side, formal, and for wishes rather than congratulations).
vocabulary_notes: तुम्हीं — तुम plus ही. You and nobody else.
होंगे here is the presumptive from Module 12: they must be happy, not they will be.
पार्टी कब दे रहे हो? — present continuous doing near-future, and a question that is really an expectation.

options: He has got a new job

game.question_en: What does the last line show about what follows good news?
options: The sender wants to organise something
The person with the good news is expected to treat everyone
They are asking about an event already planned
game.explanation_en: The message opens with delight and closes by claiming a party, without either being negotiated. The obligation is assumed, not requested.

summary.recap_en: Business messages mix registers on purpose, and a group announcement borrows officialese for its apology and WhatsApp for its request. लगना adds a seventh job — a job landing. And -दार from level 5 turns up in हक़दार in a text message.
summary.next_up_en: Next: an invitation, an apology and a favour — the three things messages are most often for.

lines.english: Hello everyone

lines.hindi: अगले रविवार शाम 6 बजे सोसाइटी पार्क में होली मिलन का कार्यक्रम है
lines.read_as: agle ravivaar shaam 6 baje sosaaiṭii paark meṁ holii milan kaa kaaryakram hai
lines.english: There is a Holi gathering next Sunday at 6 p.m. in the society park
Everyone please come with your families
Food and drink are arranged

lines.hindi: अपने साथ कुर्सी लाने की ज़रूरत नहीं
lines.read_as: apne saath kursii laane kii zaruurat nahiiṁ
lines.english: No need to bring your own chairs
Please arrive on time
See you there!

learn.title_en: सहित — a postposition that follows nothing
learn.explanation_en: परिवार सहित means with family, and सहित is unusual in Hindi because it sits directly after the noun with no के in front of it. Compare परिवार के साथ, which means the same and is what people say. सहित is Sanskrit-side and slightly ceremonial, which is exactly right for a residents' association invitation. Note also लाने की ज़रूरत नहीं — the ज़रूरत construction from level 1, with the oblique infinitive and की, meaning there is no need to.
learn.register_note_en: सहित (formal, written) · के साथ (everywhere). A friend inviting you would say परिवार के साथ आना.
vocabulary_notes: शामिल होना — to join or take part. शामिल is invariable.
इंतज़ाम — arrangement, masculine, Urdu-side.
मिलन — a gathering or meeting, from मिलना. होली मिलन is a standard name for a Holi get-together.

practice.question_en: What are people told they need not bring?
practice.explanation_en: Line 5: कुर्सी लाने की ज़रूरत नहीं.

game.question_en: Why does the message mention chairs at all?
options: People would normally bring their own, so it is worth saying they need not
game.explanation_en: It is listing what has been taken care of. Mentioning chairs alongside food only makes sense if bringing them was the default expectation.

lines.english: Hello auntie

lines.hindi: कल आपके यहाँ नहीं आ सका, इसके लिए क्षमा चाहता हूँ
lines.read_as: kal aapke yahaaṁ nahiiṁ aa sakaa, iske lie kṣamaa chaahtaa huuṁ
lines.english: I couldn't come to you yesterday, and I'm sorry for that

lines.hindi: अचानक ऑफ़िस का काम आ गया था
lines.read_as: achaanak ôfis kaa kaam aa gayaa thaa
lines.english: Some office work came up suddenly

lines.hindi: आपने इतनी तैयारी की थी, बहुत बुरा लगा
lines.read_as: aapne itnii taiyaarii kii thii, bahut buraa lagaa
lines.english: You had made such preparations — I felt terrible

lines.hindi: इस रविवार ज़रूर आऊँगा, माफ़ कीजिएगा
lines.read_as: is ravivaar zaruur aauuṁgaa, maaf kiijiegaa
lines.english: I'll definitely come this Sunday. Do forgive me

learn.title_en: क्षमा and माफ़ी in the same short message
learn.explanation_en: Line 2 says क्षमा चाहता हूँ, which is Sanskrit-side and rather formal. Line 5 says माफ़ कीजिएगा, which is Urdu-side and everyday. They mean the same thing, they are three lines apart, and the writer is not confused. Hindi speakers move across this axis inside a single message without noticing, and a learner who is told to pick one side will write sentences that sound stiffer than anything a native speaker produces. Module 15 gives this two full levels; this message is the evidence.
learn.register_note_en: क्षमा चाहता हूँ (formal, written, and a shade ceremonial) · माफ़ कीजिए (everyday) · सॉरी (extremely common and not rude). All three are current Hindi.
vocabulary_notes: नहीं आ सका — सकना in the negative, from Module 11: I was unable, which is gentler than saying I did not come.
आपके यहाँ — at your place. यहाँ after a possessive means somebody's home.
बुरा लगा — लगना again, for how something felt.

practice.explanation_en: Line 3: अचानक ऑफ़िस का काम आ गया था.

game.question_en: What does आपने इतनी तैयारी की थी add to the apology?
options: It asks her to prepare again
It suggests the occasion was not important
It explains why he could not come
It acknowledges the trouble she went to, not only his absence
game.explanation_en: The first apology covers his absence. This line apologises for a second thing — her wasted effort — which the earlier line does not touch.

lines.english: Hello bhabhi ji
I had a small request

lines.hindi: कल सुबह हमें बाहर जाना है और कोरियर वाला आने वाला है
lines.read_as: kal subah hameṁ baahar jaanaa hai aur koriyar vaalaa aane vaalaa hai
lines.english: We have to go out tomorrow morning and a courier is due

lines.hindi: आप पैकेट ले लेंगी तो बड़ी मेहरबानी होगी
lines.read_as: aap paikeṭ le leṁgii to baṛii mehrbaanii hogii
lines.english: If you could take the parcel it would be very kind
We'll collect it in the evening
Do say if it's any trouble
Thank you very much

learn.title_en: गुज़ारिश थी — a present request in the past tense
learn.explanation_en: एक छोटी सी गुज़ारिश थी means "I have a small request", and it is in the past tense on purpose. Putting a request one step back in time makes it smaller and easier to refuse — the same instinct English follows in "I was wondering whether". Line 6 does the other half of the job: दिक्कत हो तो बता दीजिएगा hands her a way out before she has to look for one. Between them, the message asks for a favour while making it as easy as possible to say no.
learn.register_note_en: That completes the request set: निवेदन (formal, upwards, level 19) · अनुरोध (neutral) · गुज़ारिश (warm and personal, Urdu-side). All three are requests; the distance is what differs.
vocabulary_notes: मेहरबानी — kindness, Persian-derived. बड़ी मेहरबानी होगी is a fixed phrase.
आने वाला है — about to come. The वाला construction for imminence.
छोटी सी — सा softening a size, and both words feminine because गुज़ारिश is.

practice.question_en: What is she being asked to do?

game.question_en: The request uses a past tense for something happening now. What is that doing?
options: It softens the request, and the line near the end does the same job
The request has already been refused
It repeats a request made earlier
game.explanation_en: थी puts the asking one step away, and the offer to hear about any difficulty gives her a refusal she does not have to invent. Both lines are doing politeness rather than carrying information.

summary.recap_en: सहित follows its noun with no के, unlike के साथ. क्षमा and माफ़ी appear three lines apart in one apology, which is normal Hindi rather than confusion. And a request in the past tense — गुज़ारिश थी — is politeness, not chronology.
summary.next_up_en: Next: back to vocabulary — Sanskrit-side and Urdu-side pairs, taught as choices rather than as rivals.
